title: Frobenius nonclassicality of generalized Fermat curves with respect to conics
summary: The effective application of the Stöhr-Voloch theory for the linear system of plane curves of a fixed degree to bound the number of rational points of a family of plane curves defined over $\mathbb{F}_q$ requires the characterization of the $\mathbb{F}_q$-Frobenius nonclassical curves in the family. In this paper, we provide necessary and sufficient conditions for certain generalized Fermat curves $\mathcal{F}$ defined over $\mathbb{F}_q$ to be $\mathbb{F}_q$-Frobenius nonclassical with respect to the linear system of conics.
